title: The IsUpMap lets you check the status of over 100 major sites at once
summary: IsUpMap is a web-based tool that displays the real-time uptime status of over 100 major websites on a single visual map, allowing users to quickly diagnose widespread service outages without checking each site individually.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of manually checking multiple websites one by one when diagnosing potential service outages.
why_valuable: Provides a one-glance overview of internet service health, saving time for developers and sysadmins during incident response.
